title: Configure Many-to-Many Relationships
description: Learn to configure many-to-many relationships using a joining entity.

data.text: EF Core requires an explicit joining entity for many-to-many relationships. There are no default conventions for automatic configuration.

items: Define a joining entity class with foreign keys for both entities
Define one-to-many relationships between entities and joining entity
Configure composite key for the joining entity
